events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, drawing hundreds of thousands to a dairy farm in upstate New York for "3 Days of Peace & Music".

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and mayhem of Woodstock! Which legendary performance still gives you goosebumps?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the music world lost the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock Tribute
angles.copy: 49 years since the King left the building. Elvis Presley's legacy is undeniable. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by incident in Las Vegas, tragically passing away six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: 30 years ago today, Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas. His music continues to influence generations. What's his most impactful track for you?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away at the age of 27, leaving an indelible mark on music.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work truly changed the game. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: The iconic 'Abbey Road' album turns 57 today! That zebra crossing is still one of the most famous album covers ever. What's your top track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are unmistakable. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from him?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971, featuring his timeless title track.

angles.name: Lennon's Vision
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us the powerful 'Imagine' album. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed portable music forever. How many songs did your first iPod hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Favourites
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, and all those iconic theme tunes, who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message still inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment of his genius?

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Beatles Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'! A sprawling masterpiece of diverse sounds. What's your standout track from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Queen Legend Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years since the world lost the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
